snippet.title: Oaks vs Orcs | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
⭐ Wishlist Oaks vs Orcs on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4946780/Oaks_vs_Orcs/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announce&utm_content=announcement_trailer

Bend The River. Break The Game. Oaks vs Orcs is a roguelike strategy autobattler where water is your most powerful weapon, and you choose where it flows.

- Build a forest kingdom on an expanding tactical grid
- Place units and defences, then watch them battle automatically
- Shape the river to stack powerful bonuses and activate terrain
- Adapt your strategy as the seasons transform the battlefield
- Explore deep strategic options through 4 campaigns and 100+ unique cards
- Face escalating orc hordes, powerful bosses and endless challenges

Coming to PC in 2027. From Chaos Theory Games, the Sydney studio behind Crab God and Australian Studio of the Year 2024.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/hrtSM5yKsn
Press kit: https://www.chaostheorygames.com/oaks-vs-orcs-press-kit
